the development of character education programs is an important part of teacher education.

The main takeaway from our work is that
character and citizenship education is an essential component of the liberal arts curriculum.
pre-service preparation for teaching character and citizenship should not be viewed as a separate entity, but rather as an integrated approach.
character education is a process that is most effective when it is infused into all aspects of the school environment, not just in the classroom or in isolated programs.
